name: sqlite-vec-pnpm-bench
description: M1 plan todo 2 (docs/adr/sqlite-vec-packaging-validation.md §3-③ rerun duty): verify better-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec load inside an electron-builder asar package with node_modules installed by PNPM (symlink layout, node_modules/.pnpm virtual store). Standalone sandbox: NOT part of the pnpm workspace (bench/* is outside pnpm-workspace.yaml globs). Core difference vs the M0 npm-layout sandbox (bench/sqlite-vec-electron, package-lock.json): this directory ships its own pnpm-lock.yaml and no package-lock.json. electron/better-sqlite3 versions pinned to the workspace values so the electron ABI stays 130 and results stay comparable with the M0 ADR run.
